Using ATR for stop‑loss and take‑profit scales risk to current volatility, ensuring consistent risk‑reward ratios across varying market conditions.

The strategy will profit better by only taking mean‑reversion trades when the trend strength is weak (ADX < 25). This reduces false breakouts in strong trending markets, where Bollinger band extremes are more likely to be sustained rather than reversed, improving Sharpe and reducing drawdown.
